BiblicalUsage: Shame — Paul speaks to the Corinthians' shame twice: there is not a wise man among them to judge between brethren in 1 Corinthians 6:5, and some have not the knowledge of God in 1 Corinthians 15:34.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul uses shame as a spur, not a whip — he names what is wrong so the church will wake up and put it right.
